title: Uniform full-B2 coefficient4 with log(N)^(901/100) loglog(N)^4 remainder

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"One fixed total guarded language evaluated by family.py. N<128 outputs0; larger inputs have L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L),A=ceil(L^(1/100)),actual L-bit header S-1. With P2 rounding: h=e=P2(S L^2 z),ell=P2(S^3 L^2 z),eprime=P2(S^5 L^4 z^2),d=P2(S^9 L^4 A z^2),Y=P2(S^11 L^7 A z^3),k=P2(S^13 L^9 A z^4). Initial D11 A1 has precisionceil(L/28)+10,exact rational field and adaptive B1,seedcap5L. Four internal maps use B2.1 affine extraction at FIXED dimension1024,K=128*h*A*M,charged field/matrix packages,at most2 eventual A1calls and exact stipulated ell-seed guard. Setq0=(4h+128hA+10)ell. Short E1 is direct B2.3. B5 is the fully supplied logarithmic-external-seed bootstrap: r-bit source padded to n=P2(r),w=ceil(log2 r),two1024-wise polynomial bit samplers,ell_s=n//2176000,kappa=ell_s//16000,weak outputM1=kappa//8,weak shared-field seedD1=5*(1000w)^2+2000w,direct A1D4 helper outputP2(D1),errorlog160w+10,and ceil((m-c)/M1) fresh external-seed rounds. Prefix hash degree1000w,lengthc250w supplies shifted agreement. Sampler scalar error and all entropy/helper guards are exact program checks. Entire G is generally nonlinear; only strong general extraction and shifted agreement are used. Layout delta1/125,m=floor(r/125),b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w/(30*125^2)),u=2b+2w+10. Initial and four internal A1 matrices/fields, B5prefix modulus,sampler field and helper A1 data are charged input bits. Short E1 has no data. Every failed plan outputs0,all headers/data are evaluated by one polynomial-time algorithm. A fixed good S0 is only a charged hard restriction. Eventuald0<4L,P=O_S0(L^2 z)=o(k) and initialbad2N^(-1/28) versus S_groups^delta<=2^((4/125)L) close the bound.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^(901/100)*(log2(log2 N))^4. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^(901/100)*(log2(log2 N))^(4+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(901/100+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=O_S0(L^2*ceil(log2 L))=o(k), including the four internal dimension1024 packages. The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact algebra, code packing and scalar-planner checks. Includes exact logarithmic A1 field formula, charged internal dimension1024 scalar plans, actual package parsing/call slicing, sampler tree caps/moments and bootstrap seed mocks, retained auxiliary hash/field/linearity/circuit identities. Positive enormous scalar plans allocate no corresponding field/input/seed. Auxiliary half-output tests do not assert those routines define the four new internal maps. Finite checks do not prove universal correctness or execute the eventual complete family.
